footnotes: Run 1 (box-1) was measured again on 2026-11-12/13, on the same box, with a collector that records which cgroup the kernel charges for the box's filesystem-metadata writeback; it replaces the run of 2026-11-08 (`data/2026/superseded/cycle-1/`). That run was charged 15.8 MB of disk writes in its first eight hours; this one was charged nothing after its install, in 25 hours, while the box's metadata writeback (163 MB over the run) was charged to other cgroups throughout. `docs/RUN-2026-slot5.md` has the cause and the rule under which the run was replaced.

The pilot run measured v1.5.0, which wrote 115 MB per 24 h to its on-disk export queue. v1.7.0 keeps a batch in memory for up to 15 s and writes it to disk only if it is still undelivered; the re-run was scheduled after that release, so that this row, like every other, is the agent's current release.
